correctness.rationale: The graph is fully specified as GP(10,2), with perfect matchings and octagonal symmetric-difference moves unambiguously defined. Exhaustive recursion visits all 36 states without duplication. A pairwise symmetric-difference construction and a separately coded facial-cycle toggle construction both produce 120 identical edges and the same canonical SHA-256. Independent breadth-first-search and Floyd–Warshall computations recover the exact eccentricities and layer arrays. Complement two-factor traversals and adjacency checks establish every structural assertion (six degree-ten versus thirty degree-six configurations, two common neighbours, and the connected two-regular C10 induced neighbourhoods). Two runnable checkers and a complete 36-state adjacency certificate are embedded, with successful captured replays. These finite exhaustive checks are proofs for the fixed graph only; no infinite extrapolation is made.

evidence: Ito et al., arXiv:1907.01700 §1.2, proves algorithms and hardness for all alternating cycles, including general always-possible connectivity, but does not restrict every move to an octagon.

Aluoch (2019) sets cycle-set independence and width at most two as hypotheses and obtains bipartite induced-cube behavior. The thirty dodecahedral octagons are linearly dependent because the twenty-vertex thirty-edge connected graph has cycle-space dimension eleven. The directly certified octagonal reconfiguration graph contains sixty triangles.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Allowing arbitrarily long flips only adds edges, so its general connectedness cannot imply connectivity or diameter three of the subgraph using exactly length-eight flips. Results for independent even-cycle families cannot be transferred to all thirty dependent octagons. A bipartite-cube conclusion would contradict the observed triangles, confirming inapplicability.

originality.rationale: The 36 matching count and six-versus-thirty matching classes occur in earlier enumerations and are not separately claimed new. The new assertion is the complete *shortest-even-cycle* flip graph, its three-step diameter and its exceptional-neighbour structure. Earlier hexagonal fullerene resonance is vacuous on the pentagon-only dodecahedron; the unrestricted-cycle reconfiguration theorem does not imply exact octagon-only reachability; cycle-independence resonance theorems cannot apply to all thirty dependent octagons. Equivalence, broader-theorem, existing-table and implication comparisons were explicitly performed against the inspected primary texts and targeted scientific searches. Residual risk is unindexed or inaccessible equivalent data; this is not an independent historical-priority certificate.
residual_risks: Unindexed literature or supplementary tables could contain equivalent octagon-restricted state graph invariants.

value.rationale: The dodecahedron is the canonical smallest fullerene, on which standard hexagonal resonance has no moves. The boundary of two adjacent pentagons is its shortest even cycle, making octagonal-flip reconfiguration a geometrically motivated, nonarbitrary next operation. The exact fact that all 36 matching states communicate in at most three such shortest flips is not implied by their count, and the six special configurations, induced C10 neighbourhoods, and pairwise multiplicity-two intersections expose nontrivial local architecture. These concrete data benchmark shortest-even-cycle resonance on odd-faced polyhedral graphs and can support meaningful extensions without any asserted general theorem.
